function: Prior to defining moving load, Code must be selected first from Moving Load Analysis Data > Moving Load.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Load] tab > [Type : Moving Load] > [Moving Load Code] group > [Moving Load Code]
usage:
Note 1
The following codes are provided: [Korea, AASHTO Standard, AASHTO LRFD, PENNDOT, Canada, BS, Eurocode, Transverse]

Note 2
Once a Code is selected, all the MVL related dialog boxes are changed accordingly.
